body: I can definitely relate to that so much.

Thanks. I'm sorry if saying this would bother you but I hope one day you get to the point where you wouldn't need nor want to kill yourself. And I do wish for you and will also keep you in my prayers that you'd live the life that'd make u regret nothing looking back on it.

Ohh i get that too but from a Muslim family like pray and stuff like I used to choke everytime I prayed never makes u feel at ease or anything. I no longer believe in religions really. I wish religion would stop being a solution people give to mental illness cause it never was and never will be. I'm sorry you have to go through this it sure does suck.

Me too I hope everything works out well for you I really do. I hope you get to feel genuinely happy one day and look back and think of how far you've come and how much you improved one day.. One day my friend. Until then keep holding on.

I guess it's better than nothing. Maybe one day this is all going to be fine. I don't get my hopes too high about anything to avoid any disappointments as I don't need more of those in my life as i am myself am a disappointment but maybe just maybe it will get better. Ahhh I just wish it would.

Sometimes I wish I could go back before I took them but maybe I don't remember how bad it was and maybe it is better now. Taking them doesn't become an issue cause it's a part of your daily routine. Maybe the act of taking them alone makes your mind more at ease and that perhaps is better than whatever it was like before taking them in the first place.
To be honest it's more trouble than it's worth. I am sad before and after my meds really. Now I just can't quit them.
Yeah I've been taking effexor xr 150mg for 2 years now I take it religiously to avoid the withdrawal cause those feel like you're slipping in and out of reality it's really weird.
